ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-20-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Loretta M. Norris, Clerk: P. Dias, Reporter: Robert Balian, Bailiff: Henry. Petitioner Karen Martinez represented by Mary J. Bosworth, Esq. was sworn and examined. Father resides in Peru and no response from father regarding the name change. Court signs decree changing name - Confidential and on file with Secretary of State.
